poll.source_locator: Q4 'If the November 2026 general election for Michigan governor were held tomorrow': Democrat Jocelyn Benson 52, Republican John James 43, Libertarian Anthony Hudson 1, U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate Donna Brandenburg 1, Green Party candidate Douglas Campbell <0.5, Not sure / Refused 3
poll.notes: other = Hudson 1 + Brandenburg 1 + Campbell <0.5. Field dates Oct 23-25 per the Michigan tabs header; the blog post (https://www.dataforprogress.org/blog/2026/10/30/democratic-senate-candidates-lead-in-maine-michigan-and-texas) gives Oct 23-27 for the three-state set and Benson 52-43. WIKIPEDIA ERROR: the MI governor page lists this poll as 50-46 with 3% undecided, which are the Senate numbers (El-Sayed 50, Rogers 46); 270toWin has 52-43. MoE +/-4. Same sample as the MI Senate item.
